messages:
Maya: Opening Cerès POC thread. They returned the auth checklist and want concrete answers for SSO/SAML, SCIM behaviour, RBAC mapping, domain verification, and a short hosted vs dedicated pricing note. Also security wants a clear statement about IdP outage fallback. @Ethan @Rochelle can you help?

Ethan: SCIM defaults: delta_window = 900s (15m). For Dedicated we can reduce to 300s; for short POC bursts we can temporarily enable 60s but we monitor load. Default rate limit = 300 req/min/tenant; POC bump to 600 req/min is acceptable for 7-14 days. Recommend initial seed via batch endpoint to avoid throttles.

Rochelle: RBAC pattern: we read roles from the SAML attribute named `roles` (comma-separated) and we also accept SCIM group->role mappings. Customers upload an explicit mapping file in the console; we don't infer admin privileges. Delegated-admin mode is opt-in and produces extra audit events. Example mapping we suggest: `okta:AppAdmin -> platform_admin`, `azure:Viewer -> read_only`.

Maya: Domain proof — they want to confirm email subdomain ownership for password reset flows. Which methods do we support?

Ethan: We support DNS TXT verification (recommended), HTTP file-token check, and signed SAML metadata as ownership proof. For email subdomains DNS TXT is the fastest and least intrusive.

Samir: Short statement for security questionnaire about IdP downtime: "When enabled, an email magic-link fallback is available; on Dedicated deployments this fallback requires outbound email and may be restricted by customer network/KMS policies. All fallback sign-ins are logged and auditable."

Maya: Hosted vs Dedicated quick note for sales: Hosted POC = usage-based with trial credits; Dedicated = reserved monthly commit sized by QPS and synced users. Dedicated allows private KMS, VPC egress controls, and custom SCIM tuning. Sales should collect expected users, daily deltas, and group counts for sizing.

Rochelle: SCIM test snippet for docs: `PATCH /scim/v2/Users` body: `[ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "alice@ceres.co" } ]`. Config example: `scim.delta_window_seconds=900; scim.rate_limit_per_min=300; scim.batch_enabled=true`.

DevOps-Bot: Staging tenant deploy scheduled 2026-05-10T03:00:00Z for Cerès POC — no prod impact.

Maya: Action items: @Ethan provide formal SCIM SLA + temporary 60s note by EOD; @Rochelle draft RBAC mapping example and the one-line security answer; Sales to gather user counts. I'll compile answers into the questionnaire PDF and attach. Thanks :thumbsup:
